rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: Weekend, US equity markets closed → spot crypto only (leveraged crypto ETFs trade equity hours only). Macro tape is risk-off: Middle East tensions escalating (Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia), Brent crude >$83/bbl, and crypto is range-bound waiting on the next catalyst — BTC pinned near $65k, ETH ~$1,900, SOL ~$75. No fresh 24h catalyst strong enough to justify a high-beta bet; the market is 'waiting rather than breaking out.'
positions.driver: LONG BTC spot, 100% capital, no leverage (crypto weekend). On a low-edge, risk-off weekend the objective favors the most defensive spot expression with the best downside protection: BTC is the lowest-vol major and holds the $63-64k support shelf, so a weekend bounce or safe-haven bid is captured while drawdown risk is minimized. Chose BTC over: SOL (real catalyst — Anza SIMD-0525 client upgrade cutting slot times 400ms→200ms and rent ~90% — but mainnet activation is ~9 days out the week of Aug 17, NOT next-24h, and SOL is higher-beta into a risk-off weekend = more downside); ETH (range-bound ~$1,900, no fresh catalyst, mid-beta); staying in UGL (equity ETF, cannot trade weekend). Entry 64930.71 = dashboard live proxy quote, asOf 2026-08-08T11:40:59Z. Stop 58437.64 (-10%, spot-crypto band).
positions.risks: Weekend crypto liquidity is thin and there are no circuit breakers, so a risk-off deepening (oil spike, Middle East headlines) can gap BTC through $63k support sharply. Opportunity cost if SOL front-runs its Aug 17 upgrade or a risk-on reversal favors higher-beta alts. Mitigants: -10% hard stop caps loss; BTC is the least-volatile major (structural downside protection vs alts); daily rotation limits the hold to ~24h; sizing is spot (no leverage amplification).
